description:
Ellie, who runs a restaurant in the capital, is an unfriendly but conscientious chef. While he's living peacefully, he falls for his regular customer's trick and is forced to accompany him on a suspicious trip… 

The rest of the group, a cruel swordsman and a playboy mage, cannot be trusted, and the endless journey is dangerous. A forest with ancient trees, a mountain range where snow leopards lurk, a cooking competition in a fancy city, and even a thief in a ballroom. A strange adventure awaits them. 

Chester, a fearless prosecutor, began a journey he thought was troublesome, but then developed a weakness that he didn't want to reveal to anyone. Pablo Fairvissel, one of the 17 wise men and a royal doctor, finds himself at a crossroads between cowardice and loyalty when he discovers suspicious circumstances during a mission he considered a vacation. 

The group gets closer day by day, and before they know it, they have set foot in the enemy country. Will they be able to return to Antilla after their arduous journey? A story of a grand conspiracy, inevitable fate, and insignificant heroes who conflict within it.
